verdict.rationale: MX documents developer API keys issued from the Client Dashboard, with a key-rotation flow in which the previous key expires after 30 days, so credentials can be issued and rotated for an agent integration. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be limited by permission, product, or resource, so the least-privilege core of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: scoped or permission-limited API keys, per-agent or per-purpose credential issuance, least-privilege controls documentation, independent corroboration.
